import itertools

def solve(facts):
    jobs = facts['jobs']
    n = len(jobs)
    ids = [j['id'] for j in jobs]
    ix = {x:i for i,x in enumerate(ids)}
    best = None
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(n)):
        pos = [0]*n
        for k,i in enumerate(p): pos[i]=k
        if any(pos[ix[a]] > pos[i] for i,j in enumerate(jobs) for a in j['predecessors']):
            continue
        t=0; starts=[]; cost=0
        for i in p:
            j=jobs[i]
            t=max(t,j['release'])
            for a in j['predecessors']:
                if pos[ix[a]] >= pos[i]: break
            s=t; starts.append(s); t=s+j['duration']
            cost += j['weight']*max(0,t-j['due'])
        seq=tuple(ids[i] for i in p)
        key=(cost,t,seq)
        if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key, {'order':list(seq),'starts':starts,'finish':t,'weighted_tardiness':cost})
    return best[1]

def check(answer,facts):
    jobs=facts['jobs']; n=len(jobs)
    by={j['id']:j for j in jobs}
    order=answer['order']; starts=answer['starts']
    if len(order)!=n or len(set(order))!=n or set(order)!=set(by) or len(starts)!=n: return False
    t=0; cost=0
    for k,x in enumerate(order):
        j=by[x]
        if any(order.index(p)>=k for p in j['predecessors']): return False
        s=max(t,j['release'])
        if starts[k]!=s: return False
        t=s+j['duration']; cost+=j['weight']*max(0,t-j['due'])
    if answer['finish']!=t or answer['weighted_tardiness']!=cost: return False
    best=(cost,t,tuple(order))
    # Independent exhaustive schedule enumeration with direct feasibility and objective calculation.
    optimum=None
    for seq in itertools.permutations(by.keys()):
        loc={x:i for i,x in enumerate(seq)}
        if any(loc[p]>=loc[x] for x in seq for p in by[x]['predecessors']): continue
        tm=0; val=0
        for x in seq:
            j=by[x]; tm=max(tm,j['release'])+j['duration']
            val+=j['weight']*max(0,tm-j['due'])
        key=(val,tm,seq)
        if optimum is None or key<optimum: optimum=key
    return best==optimum
